description: Brightway is an open-source software framework for life cycle assessment written in Python. LCA evaluates the environmental impacts of a good or service by analysing the inputs and outputs of its whole supply chain, including raw materials, energy use and wastes. Brightway is built to handle large datasets and fast, accurate calculations, with an emphasis on flexibility and performance that lets users go beyond conventional LCA; its community is strong in academia and growing among industry and consulting users worldwide. The documentation covers LCA theory, step-by-step tutorials, a glossary, a cheat sheet of common commands and a live JupyterLite demo that runs without installation. The packages are on PyPI under the BSD-3-Clause licence: the brightway25 wrapper (version 1.1.1, November 2025, Python 3.9 or later) installs Brightway 2.5, whose calculation engine bw2calc is at version 2.5.0. Caveats: it is a programming library, not a point-and-click tool, and it needs inventory databases that the user supplies. For simulation it computes life cycle impacts of infrastructure systems and supply chains and can be scripted into optimisation or scenario workflows. Related catalogue records include openLCA, pymrio and EXIOBASE.
